These simple quantity-question forms fit those attested extensions; unexplained loss of t or added aspiration is left for local review. Reviewed comparison: Goj kitnā “how many?” (f_4m2ukw5lzzic6). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
